{{Quote|Dee'ja Peak is probably the most beautiful mountain town on Naboo. I'm lucky to work here.|[[Vance Groten]]|<ref name="SWG:GtVG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Go to Vance Groten|Naboo}}</ref>}}
'''Dee'ja Peak''' was a scenic [[City/Legends|city]] nestled within the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], on top of an eponymous peak on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] known as the Dee'ja peak.

==Description==
[[File:DeejaPeak2-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dee'ja Peak]]
Dee'ja Peak was a secluded town nestled deep within a mountain valley. The city catered to those who wanted to get away from it all, and many residents of Dee'ja Peak chose to live there because of the independent lifestyle. Its inhabitants were highly welcoming as it used to be a long way to reach the city.<ref name="SWG:DP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Dee'ja Peak|Naboo}}</ref>

The city was built close to a great waterfall<ref name="SWG:DPW" /> and was famed for its stunning views.<ref name="SWG:DP" /> The waterfall of Dee'ja Peak was famous and considered one of the most beautiful in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG:DPW" />

==History==
{{Quote|I was hoping you could help me by reducing some of the threats to the Dee'ja Peak area. Like the Naboo pirates or the Maulers. Oh, and feral shaupauts have been wreaking havoc. Especially the one known as Blot.|Vance Groten, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKDPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help Keep Dee'Ja Peak Safe|Naboo}}</ref>}}
[[File:DeejaPeakNomads-CrisisOnNaboo.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A nomadic tribe arriving at Dee'ja Peak and settling there]]
Dee'ja Peak was one of the first settlements established on the planet Naboo. It was founded by a nomadic tribe of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] who came to colonize the planet many centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The tribe was venturing into the Gallo Mountains when they discovered the location of Dee'ja Peak. They settled a small village there and developed a farming community.<ref name="CoN">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep418|text="Crisis on Naboo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many people seeking independence moved to Dee'ja Peak because they disagreed with [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]]'s support of the Empire.<ref name="SWG:DP" /> However, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the city eventually became an Imperial stronghold. Dee'ja Peak was controlled by the Empire and had many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] patrolling the streets.<ref name="GG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Vance Groten]] recruited [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] agents to eliminate groups of [[Maulers]] and [[Naboo pirates]], as well as [[Blot]]'s pack of aggressive feral [[shaupaut]]s, near Dee'ja Peak.<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" />

==Inhabitants==
Residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin included [[Arven Wendik/Legends|Arven Wendik]], [[Damalia Korde]], [[Kima Nazith]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Uwo Poal]],<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> [[Herman Pate]], [[Zanier Hudmasse]], [[Tanoa Vills]], Vance Groten, [[Walker Luskeske]] and [[Ruab]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
While the spelling of this city was ''Deeja Peak'' in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', an alternate spelling of ''Dee'ja Peak'' was used in the following ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]'' spin-off novel. ''Star Wars Galaxies'' has since adapted to the book's spelling.
